skills.description: This skill turns a plain-language description into a single-file HTML poster (海报 / 长图 / 对比图 / 结营卡 / 打卡提醒), then adds a one-click export-to-image button so the result can be shared as a PNG. Use it when a user wants to make a poster, infographic, comparison card, event or recap card, or quote card but would otherwise struggle to write image-generation prompts. The skill leverages that LLMs are far better at writing HTML/CSS than at crafting image prompts, and that HTML can carry poster or PPT style information richly, interactively, and openably in any browser. Trigger phrases include 做个海报, 做成图片, 生成对比图, 结营海报, 打卡提醒, 长图, 把这段内容做成海报.

This skill should be used when the user needs to draft professional communications (emails, messages) for cross-cultural affiliate network operations.
